topic: The opening theme that contains a hidden message when played backwards
hook: Play this anime opening backwards. You'll hear a hidden message.
script: Play this anime opening backwards. You'll hear a hidden message. Multiple anime openings contain deliberate reversed audio messages called backmasking. The Fullmetal Alchemist Brotherhood opening contains reversed lyrics warning about the nature of the philosopher's stone. Death Note's opening reversed audio spells out plot elements from the final arc. These weren't discovered by fans for years. Planned. Hidden. Waiting. Follow for anime secrets hidden in plain sight.
